source_caption:
📺 The Last of Us (2023–Present)

The Last of Us follows Joel, a hardened survivor living in a world devastated by a deadly fungal infection that has transformed much of humanity into terrifying creatures. Twenty years after civilization collapses, Joel is assigned to escort Ellie, a teenage girl who may hold the key to humanity’s survival, across a dangerous and unpredictable America. As they travel through abandoned cities and hostile territories, they encounter infected creatures, ruthless survivors, and heartbreaking challenges that test their courage and trust. What begins as a dangerous mission gradually develops into a powerful bond between two people who have experienced unimaginable loss. Based on the acclaimed video game, The Last of Us delivers an emotional story about survival, love, sacrifice, and the lengths people will go to protect those they care about.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Horror • Action • Adventure

⭐ IMDb: 8.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 45–80 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creators: Craig Mazin & Neil Druckmann

🏆 Awards: Winner of multiple Primetime Emmy Awards.

📺 Where to Watch: HBO Max in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: The Last of Us is an American post-apocalyptic drama television series created by Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann for HBO. Based on the video game franchise developed by Naughty Dog, the series is set decades after the collapse of society caused by a mass fungal infection that transforms its hosts into zombie-like creatures. The first season, based on 2013's The Last of Us, follows Joel (Pedro Pascal) and Ellie (Bella Ramsey) as they travel across the United States. In the second season, based on the first half of 2020's The Last of Us Part II, they have settled in Jackson, Wyoming, with Joel's brother Tommy (Gabriel Luna) and Ellie's friends Dina (Isabela Merced) and Jesse (Young Mazino).
